summary: Baidu Scholar as a Chinese-language source behind a source adapter interface (unit A): SourceInfo constants and the adapter protocol, one 0600 key file per source (openalex.key unchanged), a Baidu Scholar adapter with an atomic daily cap of 40, a 24 h cache and no AI abstract (called only by the settings page test button), merge_oa so OpenAlex and Baidu never wipe each other's open-access facts, one source-switch rule, settings rows per source with a test button, tools/source_smoke.py, docs/SOURCES.md and ADR 0039. Nothing is sent to Baidu automatically.
scope_note: Worktree baidu-scholar from main b8827e5. Critical because /api/settings gains fields, /api/source-test is new (IPC), a new key file and a new outbound host (qianfan.baidubce.com, only from the explicit test button in this unit), ARCHITECTURE.md and harness/sources.json change. Owner's approvals are quoted in ADR 0039; owner_approved stays false.

budget_impact.rationale: No model call and no token. One public keyword request to Baidu Scholar per press of the test button, using the user's own key and counted in a local daily cap of 40; no automatic request in this unit.
budget_impact.before: no Chinese source; OpenAlex key handled by a one-off module
budget_impact.after: same model cost (zero); an explicit test request to Baidu at most 40 per UTC+8 day

open_risks: Every Baidu field name, the error-code shape, the key format, the key page address, the day boundary, over-quota behaviour (refused vs billed) and whether aiAbstract is returned by default are UNVERIFIED; no real request has been made. Run tools/source_smoke.py with a real key once.
The owner still has to confirm in the Qianfan console that exceeding the free quota is refused, not billed.
Independent review not done by the implementing agent; required before release.
The settings page was tested with Node virtual pages only, not in a browser.
